payload.research_report_md:
# SERP research: engagement ring setting for active lifestyle (fast mode, 2026-10-27)

Source: DataForSEO serp_organic_live_advanced, desktop, en, depth 10. 5 cities (fast mode). Sydney needed 3 attempts, Melbourne/Dubai/Singapore 2 (API error 40101 on first try). GSC and ranked-keywords skipped per fast-mode brief.

## Volume and difficulty (Google Ads + DataForSEO Labs, Australia)
| Keyword | AU volume | KD |
|---|---|---|
| engagement ring setting for active lifestyle | below reporting threshold (null) | n/a |
| best engagement ring for active lifestyle | 10 | n/a |
| engagement ring for active hands | null | n/a |
| low profile engagement ring | 140 | 0 |
| bezel setting engagement ring | 1,900 (2,400 Jul to Sep 2026) | 0 |
| most durable engagement ring setting | 10 | n/a |

Read: the head term is tiny in AU; the qualified long tail is real but small. The setting-name terms (bezel, low profile) carry the volume and are worth earning as H2-level secondaries.

## Australia (Sydney, Melbourne)
| # | Sydney | Melbourne |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | brilliantearth.com styles and settings guide | nektanewyork.com active styles |
| 2 | revediamonds.com durable rings for active lifestyles | brilliantearth.com styles and settings guide |
| 3 | keithfieldgoldsmith.com 3 rings (2019, product cards) | angara.com 7 tips for active women (2021) |
| AU sites | qreport.com.au (jewellery insurer) #4, adc.com.au #6 | thediamondclub.com.au #4, adc.com.au #6 |
Features: AI overview in both; Reddit discussions block; video pack (Melbourne). Related: "engagement ring setting for active lifestyle australia", "gold ...", "best ...".

## United States (New York)
Top 3: revediamonds.com, brilliantearth.com, Reddit r/EngagementRings thread. Also loveandpromisejewelers, gagediamonds, blingadvisor, carbondiamonds, fascinatingdiamonds, rottermond. PAA: spend rule of thumb, how to pose with a ring, 2:1:1 jewellery rule, wearing it for life. Related: "men engagement ring setting for active lifestyle", "durable engagement ring settings", "types of ring settings and mountings".

## Middle East (Dubai)
Top 3: revediamonds.com, vrai.com, abbysparks.com. PAA adds "What is the most common engagement ring setting?" and "Is it okay to wear an engagement ring while working out?". Image pack is dominated by AU jewellers (shjewellery.com.au, kavalri.com.au).

## Asia (Singapore)
Top 3: revediamonds.com, josephjewelry.com, vrai.com. qreport.com.au #5. Related: "most durable engagement ring stones", "platinum engagement rings", "bezel set engagement ring", "low profile engagement rings".

## Pages read (notes in 02-research/pages/)
| Page | Words | Settings covered | Prices | FAQ | Gap |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brilliant Earth guide | ~3,600 | 10 style-led (halo, pave, cathedral...) | promo only | yes | active use is one bullet; no flush, tension, channel, bar; no travel |
| Reve Diamonds durable | ~1,200 | bezel, tension, channel, prong | yes | yes | 4 settings; no activity or travel care; product push |
| Keith Field Goldsmith | ~350 | 3 bezel products | yes | no | thin, 2019 |
| Nekta New York | ~1,300 | bezel, prong, channel | no | no | 3 settings; no travel |
| Angara | ~1,250 | bezel, six-prong, channel | yes | yes | gendered; no flush, tension, bar, basket |
| VRAI | ~1,300 | solitaire, halo, three stone, bezel | yes | yes | lifestyle in general, not activity |

## Cross-region summary
- Same jeweller-blog set everywhere (Reve top 2 in 4 of 5 cities; Brilliant Earth top 2 in 3). No editorial or gemmological authority ranks. Every top page is a retailer selling rings.
- Pricing shown: most product-led pages show USD prices. We show none (brief rule).
- Top concern: losing or chipping the stone (snag, knock), then comfort and metal wear.
- Common angles: bezel first, then prong count, channel over pave, platinum, rounder shapes, thick band.
- Gaps we can own: (1) one consistent test (profile height, snag risk, stone protection, upkeep) applied to all 9 settings; (2) flush, bar, half-bezel and basket vs cathedral are missing from most pages; (3) activity-by-activity guidance (dive, surf, ski gloves, climbing, gym) and travel care (flights, hotel safes, claw check before a destination wedding, overseas insurance cover) is absent everywhere; (4) gender-neutral framing; (5) no one is selling, so we can be honest with "skip it if" lines.
- Regional: AU jewellers (qreport, adc, thediamondclub, kavalri, shjewellery) appear in AU, Dubai and Singapore SERPs, so AU authority travels. Intent is global.

recommended_scope: global (one version; Australian English; no prices).

## Cannibalisation
None found in link map or SERPs (weddedwonderland.com not in any top 10). Nearest site pages are adjacent intents (ring budget, ring trends, proposal guides) and should be linked, not merged. GSC not checked (fast mode).
